column9: CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[trgupdatetblDoctem]    ON  [dbo].[STOCKTP]     AFTER INSERT, UPDATE AS  BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM inserted) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM deleted)     BEGIN         IF TRIGGER_NESTLEVEL() <= 1         BEGIN             UPDATE t             SET CASX = TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(t.LOT, 12, 1) AS INT)             FROM [B7R2_FCC].[dbo].[STOCKTP] t             INNER JOIN inserted i ON t.SP = i.SP AND t.LOT = i.LOT             WHERE LEN(t.LOT) >= 12 AND (t.CASX IS NULL OR t.CASX = 0);         END     END      DECLARE @slphieu int, @slle int;      IF (UPDATE(SLNHAP) OR EXISTS(SELECT * FROM INSERTED))     BEGIN         -- Kiểm tra xem có bản ghi nào khớp với B20Item và MinCloseQty hợp lệ (> 0) không         IF EXISTS (             SELECT 1              FROM B20Item              JOIN inserted ON B20Item.Code = inserted.PART              WHERE ISNULL(B20Item.MinCloseQty, 0) > 0         )         begin             -- Sử dụng NULLIF để tránh chia cho 0 hoặc NULL             SELECT @slphieu = FLOOR(inserted.SLNHAP / NULLIF(B20Item.MinCloseQty, 0))              FROM B20Item              JOIN inserted ON B20Item.Code = inserted.PART;              IF @slphieu IS NOT NULL AND @slphieu > 0             BEGIN                 UPDATE TOP(@slphieu) tbl_DocTem                 SET IsCreate = 1                  FROM tbl_DocTem                 JOIN inserted ON tbl_DocTem.SP = inserted.SP AND tbl_DocTem.IsCreate is NULL;             END              SELECT @slle = inserted.SLNHAP % NULLIF(B20Item.MinCloseQty, 0)              FROM B20Item              JOIN inserted ON B20Item.Code = inserted.PART;              IF ISNULL(@slle, 0) <> 0             BEGIN                 UPDATE tbl_DocTem                  SET IsCreate = 1                  FROM tbl_DocTem                 JOIN inserted ON inserted.SP = tbl_DocTem.SP AND tbl_DocTem.SLTem = @slle AND IsCreate is NULL;             END         end     END      IF (UPDATE(SLCONLAI))     BEGIN         UPDATE STOCKTP          SET SATUS = 1          FROM STOCKTP         JOIN inserted ON STOCKTP.SP = inserted.SP AND STOCKTP.LOT = inserted.LOT         WHERE STOCKTP.SLCONLAI = 0;     END END
